issue_request: FHIR-30209 was Applied/Persuasive for the CDS work group and asked for an example showing how an existing resource can be updated using ActivityDefinition/PlanDefinition action fields, with the resolution requesting an update example for an existing prescription/medication scenario.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 5369f00212df3db568bacd32d406a0be2d2a58ad and merged by HL7/fhir#3914 as commit 817bc744f3b9640e5203c94f4576ac6782cd0919. That application added PlanDefinition action-type guidance and an update example using action type update, dynamicValue path $this to select the existing resource, and a second dynamicValue to set the target field; it also adjusted the nearby medication ActivityDefinition dynamicValue language values.
additional_context: The clinical reasoning pages are in current build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and source/clinicalreasoning-module.html, and ActivityDefinition/PlanDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence discussion that changed the Jira/source interpretation.
